+package config
+
+import "time"
+
+// OS family identifiers used throughout scanning and reporting.
+const (
+	RedHat                = "redhat"
+	Debian                = "debian"
+	Ubuntu                = "ubuntu"
+	CentOS                = "centos"
+	Fedora                = "fedora"
+	Amazon                = "amazon"
+	Oracle                = "oracle"
+	FreeBSD               = "freebsd"
+	Raspbian              = "raspbian"
+	Windows               = "windows"
+	OpenSUSE              = "opensuse"
+	OpenSUSELeap          = "opensuse.leap"
+	SUSEEnterpriseServer  = "suse.linux.enterprise.server"
+	SUSEEnterpriseDesktop = "suse.linux.enterprise.desktop"
+	SUSEOpenstackCloud    = "suse.openstack.cloud"
+	Alpine                = "alpine"
+	ServerTypePseudo      = "pseudo"
+)
+
+// EOL describes the end dates of an OS release's support phases.
+// Ended is an explicit lifecycle flag for callers with vendor information;
+// phase checks use the dates so their boundaries remain deterministic.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support ended before now.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether applicable extended support ended before now.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+func supportDate(value string) time.Time {
+	if value == "" {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	date, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return date
+}
+
+func supportUntil(standard, extended string) EOL {
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: supportDate(standard), ExtendedSupportUntil: supportDate(extended)}
+}
+
+var osEOL = map[string]map[string]EOL{
+	Amazon: {
+		"2018.03":   supportUntil("2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"),
+		"2 (Karoo)": supportUntil("2025-06-30", ""),
+	},
+	RedHat: {

+		"6": supportUntil("2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"),
+	},
+	CentOS: {
+		"7": supportUntil("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": supportUntil("2021-12-31", ""),
+		"6": supportUntil("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	Oracle: {
+		"7": supportUntil("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": supportUntil("2029-05-31", ""),
+		"6": supportUntil("2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"),
+	},
+	Ubuntu: {
+		"18.04": supportUntil("2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"),
+		"14.04": supportUntil("2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"),
+		"14.10": supportUntil("2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"),
+		"21.04": supportUntil("2022-01-30", ""),
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9":  supportUntil("2022-06-30", ""),
+		"10": supportUntil("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8":  supportUntil("2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"),
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": supportUntil("2021-05-30", ""),
+		"3.11": supportUntil("2021-11-30", ""),
+		"3.12": supportUntil("2022-05-30", ""),
+		"3.9":  supportUntil("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	FreeBSD: {
+		"11": supportUntil("2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"),
+		"12": supportUntil("2023-12-31", ""),
+		"10": supportUntil("2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"),
+	},
+}
+
+// GetEOL returns lifecycle dates for a modeled family and exact release.
+func GetEOL(family string, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	eol, found := osEOL[family][release]
+	return eol, found
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestGetEOL(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct{ family, release, standard, extended string }{
+		{Amazon, "2018.03", "2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"},
+		{Amazon, "2 (Karoo)", "2025-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{RedHat, "6", "2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+		{CentOS, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{CentOS, "8", "2021-12-31", ""},
+		{CentOS, "6", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{Oracle, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Oracle, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{Oracle, "6", "2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"},
+		{Ubuntu, "18.04", "2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.04", "2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.10", "2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "21.04", "2022-01-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "9", "2022-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "10", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "8", "2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+		{Alpine, "3.10", "2021-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.11", "2021-11-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.12", "2022-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.9", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "11", "2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "12", "2023-12-31", ""},
+		{FreeBSD, "10", "2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		eol, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release)
+		if !found || eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.standard {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: standard = %v, found = %v", c.family, c.release, eol.StandardSupportUntil, found)
+		}
+		if c.extended == "" && !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() || c.extended != "" && eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.extended {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: extended = %v", c.family, c.release, eol.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {CentOS, "9"}, {Oracle, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Debian, "11"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}, {Amazon, "2 (2017.12)"}} {
+		if _, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release); found {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected mapping: %s %s", c.family, c.release)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEOLBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	eol, _ := GetEOL(Ubuntu, "14.04")
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(eol.StandardSupportUntil) || !eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(eol.StandardSupportUntil.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("standard support boundary is not strict")
+	}
+	if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(eol.ExtendedSupportUntil) || !eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("extended support boundary is not strict")
+	}
+	withoutExtended, _ := GetEOL(RedHat, "7")
+	if withoutExtended.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(time.Now()) {
+		t.Fatal("no extended phase should not be ended")
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+)
+
+// eolWarnings evaluates a target against its modeled support dates at now.
+func eolWarnings(distro config.Distro, now time.Time) []string {
+	if distro.Family == config.ServerTypePseudo || distro.Family == config.Raspbian {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	eol, found := config.GetEOL(distro.Family, distro.Release)
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", distro.Family, distro.Release)}
+	}
+
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+
+	if !now.AddDate(0, 3, 0).Before(eol.StandardSupportUntil) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"))}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package scan

+
+func TestEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	date := func(s string) time.Time { d, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s); return d }
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release string
+		now             time.Time
+		want            []string
+	}{
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", date("2015-07-31"), []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.",
+		}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.04", date("2020-01-01"), []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support available until 2024-04-30. Check the vendor site.",
+		}},
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11", date("2021-07-01"), []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.RedHat, "9", date("2021-01-01"), []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: redhat Release: 9'"}},
+		{config.Raspbian, "11", date("2021-01-01"), nil},
+		{config.ServerTypePseudo, "", date("2021-01-01"), nil},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		got := eolWarnings(config.Distro{Family: c.family, Release: c.release}, c.now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, c.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %q, want %q", c.family, c.release, got, c.want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+package version
+
+import "strings"
+
+// Major returns the portion of a version before its first dot, after an optional epoch.
+func Major(v string) string {
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(v, ':'); i >= 0 {
+		v = v[i+1:]
+	}
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(v, '.'); i >= 0 {
+		v = v[:i]
+	}
+	return v
+}

+package config
+
+import "time"
+
+// OS family identifiers used throughout scanning and reporting.
+const (
+	RedHat                = "redhat"
+	Debian                = "debian"
+	Ubuntu                = "ubuntu"
+	CentOS                = "centos"
+	Fedora                = "fedora"
+	Amazon                = "amazon"
+	Oracle                = "oracle"
+	FreeBSD               = "freebsd"
+	Raspbian              = "raspbian"
+	Windows               = "windows"
+	OpenSUSE              = "opensuse"
+	OpenSUSELeap          = "opensuse.leap"
+	SUSEEnterpriseServer  = "suse.linux.enterprise.server"
+	SUSEEnterpriseDesktop = "suse.linux.enterprise.desktop"
+	SUSEOpenstackCloud    = "suse.openstack.cloud"
+	Alpine                = "alpine"
+	ServerTypePseudo      = "pseudo"
+)
+
+// EOL describes the end dates of an OS release's support phases.
+// Ended is an explicit lifecycle flag for callers with vendor information;
+// phase checks use the dates so their boundaries remain deterministic.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support ended before now.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether applicable extended support ended before now.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+func supportDate(value string) time.Time {
+	if value == "" {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	date, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return date
+}
+
+func supportUntil(standard, extended string) EOL {
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: supportDate(standard), ExtendedSupportUntil: supportDate(extended)}
+}
+
+var osEOL = map[string]map[string]EOL{
+	Amazon: {
+		"2018.03":   supportUntil("2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"),
+		"2 (Karoo)": supportUntil("2025-06-30", ""),
+	},
+	RedHat: {
+		"7": supportUntil("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": supportUntil("2029-05-31", ""),
+		"6": supportUntil("2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"),
+	},
+	CentOS: {
+		"7": supportUntil("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": supportUntil("2021-12-31", ""),
+		"6": supportUntil("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	Oracle: {
+		"7": supportUntil("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": supportUntil("2029-05-31", ""),
+		"6": supportUntil("2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"),
+	},
+	Ubuntu: {
+		"18.04": supportUntil("2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"),
+		"14.04": supportUntil("2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"),
+		"14.10": supportUntil("2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"),
+		"21.04": supportUntil("2022-01-30", ""),
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9":  supportUntil("2022-06-30", ""),
+		"10": supportUntil("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8":  supportUntil("2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"),
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": supportUntil("2021-05-30", ""),
+		"3.11": supportUntil("2021-11-30", ""),
+		"3.12": supportUntil("2022-05-30", ""),
+		"3.9":  supportUntil("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	FreeBSD: {
+		"11": supportUntil("2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"),
+		"12": supportUntil("2023-12-31", ""),
+		"10": supportUntil("2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"),
+	},
+}
+
+// GetEOL returns lifecycle dates for a modeled family and exact release.
+func GetEOL(family string, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	eol, found := osEOL[family][release]
+	return eol, found
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestGetEOL(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct{ family, release, standard, extended string }{
+		{Amazon, "2018.03", "2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"},
+		{Amazon, "2 (Karoo)", "2025-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{RedHat, "6", "2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+		{CentOS, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{CentOS, "8", "2021-12-31", ""},
+		{CentOS, "6", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{Oracle, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Oracle, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{Oracle, "6", "2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"},
+		{Ubuntu, "18.04", "2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.04", "2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.10", "2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "21.04", "2022-01-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "9", "2022-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "10", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "8", "2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+		{Alpine, "3.10", "2021-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.11", "2021-11-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.12", "2022-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.9", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "11", "2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "12", "2023-12-31", ""},
+		{FreeBSD, "10", "2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		eol, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release)
+		if !found || eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.standard {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: standard = %v, found = %v", c.family, c.release, eol.StandardSupportUntil, found)
+		}
+		if c.extended == "" && !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() || c.extended != "" && eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.extended {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: extended = %v", c.family, c.release, eol.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {CentOS, "9"}, {Oracle, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Debian, "11"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}, {Amazon, "2 (2017.12)"}} {
+		if _, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release); found {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected mapping: %s %s", c.family, c.release)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEOLBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	eol, _ := GetEOL(Ubuntu, "14.04")
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(eol.StandardSupportUntil) || !eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(eol.StandardSupportUntil.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("standard support boundary is not strict")
+	}
+	if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(eol.ExtendedSupportUntil) || !eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("extended support boundary is not strict")
+	}
+	withoutExtended, _ := GetEOL(RedHat, "7")
+	if withoutExtended.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(time.Now()) {
+		t.Fatal("no extended phase should not be ended")
+	}
+}

+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+)
+
+// eolWarnings evaluates a target against its modeled support dates at now.
+func eolWarnings(distro config.Distro, now time.Time) []string {
+	if distro.Family == config.ServerTypePseudo || distro.Family == config.Raspbian {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	eol, found := config.GetEOL(distro.Family, distro.Release)
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", distro.Family, distro.Release)}
+	}
+
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+
+	if !now.AddDate(0, 3, 0).Before(eol.StandardSupportUntil) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"))}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package scan
+
+import (
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+)
+
+func TestEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	date := func(s string) time.Time { d, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s); return d }
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release string
+		now             time.Time
+		want            []string
+	}{
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", date("2015-07-31"), []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.",
+		}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.04", date("2020-01-01"), []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support available until 2024-04-30. Check the vendor site.",
+		}},
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11", date("2021-07-01"), []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.RedHat, "9", date("2021-01-01"), []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: redhat Release: 9'"}},
+		{config.Raspbian, "11", date("2021-01-01"), nil},
+		{config.ServerTypePseudo, "", date("2021-01-01"), nil},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		got := eolWarnings(config.Distro{Family: c.family, Release: c.release}, c.now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, c.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %q, want %q", c.family, c.release, got, c.want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+package version
+
+import "strings"
+
+// Major returns the portion of a version before its first dot, after an optional epoch.
+func Major(v string) string {
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(v, ':'); i >= 0 {
+		v = v[i+1:]
+	}
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(v, '.'); i >= 0 {
+		v = v[:i]
+	}
+	return v
+}
